title: Mtek context export
description: The document `mtek context` prints (spec/ai-and-benchmarks.md section 2, decision 0072). contextFormat 1. Keys are never added without a new contextFormat, so unknown keys are errors.

languageVersion.description: The language version this compiler build implements.

compilerVersion.description: The version of the compiler build that produced the document.

features.description: What this build implements: language constructs by name, then library items as kind:name. Derived from the build, never written by hand.

notSupported.description: What this build rejects: planned features as 'name (planned for Mn)', reserved words, and what v0.1 never accepts.

entry.description: The entry module, relative to the project root.

scene.description: The entry scene; null if the project selects none.

modules.description: Every module of the project in load order, relative to the project root.

symbols.description: The requested declarations (or the entry scene's), what is nested in them, and the declarations one reference away; in module load order and source order.

schemas.description: The registry schemas the requested declarations use, sorted by name, with the fields this build implements.

examples.description: Complete programs that mtek check accepts, most relevant first.

truncated.description: Present only when --max-bytes made the export leave something out: per section how many items were dropped and the names of the first few, lowest priority first.

count.description: How many items were left out.

names.description: The names of the first (at most 16) items left out, lowest priority first.

name.description: The declaration names from the module item down, joined by '.'.

kind.description: scene, entity, prefab, material, struct, fn, cpu_fn, const, state, param, or the keyword of a scene object (camera).

type.description: The type as written, or a short description for a declaration without one.

doc.description: The documentation comment, '///' lines joined by a line feed; empty if none.

default.description: Canonical source text; null for a field without a default.

flags.description: Some of R (required), W (writable from handlers), B (bindable), C (construction-only), in that order.
